name: Nikolai Mikhailovich
source:
Nikolai Mikhailovich is the director of "Pomidorochka" supermarket branch where Slavik is applying for a job. He describes himself as a "stern, but fatherly fair" boss. He can be overly familiar.

He respects "eternal" qualities in people, especially courage; he disdains younger generations as lost.

He is raising a daughter alone.

He loves comedy shows. He has a technical (secondary vocational) education.

He served in the ground forces.
